name: personal_tutor_chat_instructions
content: This prompt is retained only for PromptManager compatibility with older references.
Do not inject this prompt into new chat turns. The active tutor/copilot prompt contract is intentionally split into three independent PromptManager prompts:
- `visual_storyboard_runtime_v1.0.0.json` for shared overlay, storyboard, narration, timing, replay, and final-response synchronization mechanics.
- `personal_tutor_policy_v1.0.0.json` for the Personal Tutor concept-teaching rail behind `@tutor`, `@tutur`, `hey tutor`, and `hey tutur`.
- `app_copilot_policy_v1.1.0.json` for the App Copilot app-guidance and reversible-action rail behind `@copilot`, `@app-copilot`, `@appcopilot`, `hey copilot`, and `hey app copilot`.
Rail-specific behavior belongs only in the rail-specific prompt. Shared drawing and narration mechanics belong only in the storyboard runtime prompt.

metadata.description: Legacy compatibility stub for the former combined Personal Tutor/App Copilot prompt. Active chat injection composes visual_storyboard_runtime plus exactly one rail policy.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Replaced the former mixed Personal Tutor/App Copilot instruction body with a compatibility stub so active policy lives only in visual_storyboard_runtime, personal_tutor_policy, and app_copilot_policy.
